CREATE SCHEMA effects
CREATE FUNCTION effects.stable_value() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE SQL STABLE AS 'SELECT 1'
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1/0 AS z,effects.stable_value() AS x UNION ALL SELECT 2,3) q
CREATE FUNCTION effects.volatile_value() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE AS $$BEGIN RETURN 1; END$$
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1/0 AS z,effects.volatile_value() AS x UNION ALL SELECT 2,3) q
